# Offer-Nail - Full Knowledge Base

> Confirm then write an encrypted vault into hiring forms.

This is the long-form companion to llms.txt. Keep llms.txt as the short summary; put feature details, FAQ, and comparison here so AI assistants get accurate answers without having to scrape the site.

---

## Overview

Offer-Nail is a local-first Chrome and Edge extension for autumn and spring campus recruiting. A candidate keeps one encrypted structured resume on this computer, imports PDF or DOCX for review, then scans a hiring form and writes selected fields after confirmation. It never creates an account, never uploads the resume, and never clicks submit.

Author: null1024-ws (https://github.com/null1024-ws).
Source: https://github.com/null1024-ws/Offer-Nail.
Platform: Chrome and Edge (desktop Chromium). Firefox, Safari, and mobile browsers are out of scope.

## Pricing

Free. Apache-2.0. No seats and no subscription. Current distribution is a local trial pack you build with `corepack pnpm zip` / `zip:edge`. Not listed on the Chrome Web Store yet. A forgotten master password cannot be recovered; wipe local data and start again.

## Features

### Local vault
Resume files, structured records, site mapping rules, and backups stay on this device. A master password (at least 12 characters, letters and numbers) unlocks the vault for the browser session. Permissions are only `activeTab`, `scripting`, and `storage`.

### Import review
PDF with a text layer and DOCX are parsed locally into candidate fields. High-confidence empty fields can be selected; unchecked candidates never enter the fillable profile. Scanned PDFs without a text layer are not OCR'd.

### Confirmed fill
The popup scans the current tab, shows page label → profile field → proposed value, confidence, conflicts, and sensitive flags. High-confidence, non-sensitive, empty fields are selected by default. Confirm writes values and highlights them. Undo restores previous values if the page signature is unchanged.

### Job variants
One master profile holds identity facts. Variants override summary, intent, experience wording, skill order, and attachments without duplicating the whole resume.

### Site rules
Corrected mappings can be saved per site origin. Rules do not include resume values. If the page changes enough, the fill falls back to confirmation.

## How Offer-Nail differs

### vs browser Autofill
Autofill remembers logins and some form values. Offer-Nail maintains a structured resume catalog, previews every write, and will not submit the page.

### vs job-site resume parsers
Campus hiring sites often parse an uploaded file on their servers. Offer-Nail never sends the file anywhere. Mapping quality still depends on ordinary form controls, not a vendor-specific ATS contract.

### vs general-purpose tools (e.g. ChatGPT paste)
Pasting a resume into a cloud model leaves the machine. Offer-Nail has no remote AI parse and no cloud sync.

## FAQ

### What is Offer-Nail for?
Campus candidates who fill the same online resume into many company systems. It compresses that work to one local vault plus per-page confirmation.

### Who is it not for?
Anyone who needs cloud sync, Firefox or Safari, unattended mass apply, or a guarantee that every custom ATS widget will fill.

### How does it integrate with Chrome or Edge?
Load the unpacked build from `.output/chrome-mv3` or `.output/edge-mv3` on the extensions page. Chrome 137 removed `--load-extension` on the command line.

### What does the $0 buy?
The Apache-2.0 source, local trial packs, and the right to build it yourself. There is no paid tier.

### How do I get support?
Open a GitHub issue with browser version, page type (no resume body), and the error text from the popup or options page. Never include the master password.
